description: Costco parser and semantic handling policies

code_policy.description: Costco item and discount code handling rules
notes: 코드처럼 보이는 숫자라도 store pattern과 함께 검증해야 한다

apply_only_when: line is already classified as item_detail or discount_detail
code and price-like fields are confidently extracted
store pattern indicates missing qty case

amount_policy.description: Amount normalization and casting rules for Costco

line_classification_policy.description: Recommended order for Costco line classification
rules: summary lines must be checked before generic item or noise rules
discount_detail must win over item_detail when trailing minus or -T exists
discount_target lines containing IRC, EXM, or PP must not be downgraded to item_name
noise must be applied only as the final fallback

merge_policy.description: Repeated identical items may be grouped after parsing
do_not_group_when: same code appears with different semantic meaning

examples.condition: same code + same unit_price_raw + same discount state
examples.result: groupable in semantic or UI layer

parser_rules: parser must classify discount_keyword, discount_target, and discount_detail separately when possible
parser must preserve raw line_text for discount_target lines
parser must not attach discount_detail to any item
semantic_rules: if discount_target exists, try to attach discount to the matching product
if discount_target does not exist, attach discount to the previous eligible item
discount_target normalization may remove IRC, EXM, PP only after raw text is preserved

parser_rules: coupon-only lines may be classified as receipt_discount candidates when they do not contain discount detail values
receipt_discount must be preserved separately from item discount
semantic_rules: receipt_discount must not be blindly attached to a product
global coupon semantics should be resolved after full line context is available

forbidden: do not remove IRC, EXM, PP from raw text before semantic handoff
do not collapse multiple lines into one item in parser stage
do not compute final_price in parser stage

requirements: all lines must be returned, including noise
line_type must be mapped to common line type enum
store_role may be preserved as an auxiliary field

receipt_level: sum(final_price) should be reconcilable with receipt total
notes: validation is not a parser responsibility
these are hints for semantic or downstream validation stages

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: item_object_creation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 여러 줄을 하나의 상품 객체로 병합하는 것은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: final_price_calculation
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 최종 가격 계산은 semantic 단계에서 수행

forbidden_parser_behaviors.name: aggressive_noise_classification
forbidden_parser_behaviors.reason: 정상 거래 라인을 noise로 잘못 보내면 복구가 어렵다

implementation_notes: Costco는 item_detail raw order가 code + qty + unit_price + total_price인 경우가 많다
discount_detail도 유사한 구조를 가지지만 trailing minus 또는 -T가 존재한다
discount_target은 parser에서 연결하지 않고 semantic에 넘겨야 한다
동일 상품 그룹화는 semantic 또는 UI 단계에서만 수행한다
